## Services
- Free AI visibility snapshot: one customer question checked in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Mode, with competitors named, sources used and three fixes
- AI Search Audit: 20 buyer questions x 4 AI tools x 3 runs, competitor share, cited pages, 30-day fix plan. INR 35,000 / USD 750, 2 weeks
- Fix Sprint: the audit plus fixes done (brand facts, schema, up to 5 pages, outreach list) and a retest. INR 85,000 / USD 1,800, 4 weeks
- Monthly Tracking: monthly rerun, report, 2 fact-checked articles. INR 30,000 / USD 650 per month, 3-month minimum
- Packages and prices: https://arpitmehta946.github.io/services.html
- Content written to be cited by AI, fact-checked against live sources
- Getting businesses listed on the directories, review sites and roundups AI reads
- SEO and content for Google

## AI Search Lab
- Month 0 (22 Oct 2026): AI identity test. ChatGPT was unsure, Gemini found no record, Perplexity identified him from LinkedIn.
- Experiment 1 (23 Oct 2026): "Who are the best SEO agencies in Mohali?" Four AI tools named 17 agencies; none was named by all four. Rerun on 26 Oct: 21 agencies, still none in all four.
- Experiment 3 (4 Nov 2026): the same 10 searches asked to Gemini 5 times each. Gemini cited 85 different pages; 21% were in Google's top 10 (ChatGPT: 4%). Only 7 pages overlapped with ChatGPT's. 87% of Gemini's links were comparison or review articles. Results: https://arpitmehta946.github.io/lab/gemini-vs-chatgpt.html
- Experiment 2 (1 Nov 2026, published 3 Nov): 10 Indian searches asked to ChatGPT 5 times each and compared with Google's top 10. ChatGPT linked to 134 different pages; only 6 were in Google's top 10. About 2 in 3 links went to brand, institution or government pages. Results: https://arpitmehta946.github.io/lab/google-vs-chatgpt.html
